precision: Unchanged Q4_K weights, F16 embedding/head, F32 activations; inherited execution manifest and runtime configuration.
scope: Host RSS is process RAM; logical requested buffers are not physical allocations. Doppler pool capacity is a separate diagnostic snapshot. DRM client residency is driver-reported, not unique physical memory. Cold shader caches; OS file cache uncontrolled. No precision, context, pooling-budget, or output changes.
stoppingRule: Identify one avoidable overlap from qualified observations. At most one general correction. Require unchanged independent outputs, cancellation/reuse, complete matched fresh-process cohorts, material primary-memory gain, latency and allocation bounds, and no observed foreign GPU activity for acceptance. Retain failures; no outcome-selected retries. Browser contribution and transfer follow local acceptance.
